who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), lane K2b of the no-daemon command
where: crates/blaze-command/src/front.rs (Command::gather, Front::key) against crates/blaze-keyed/src/front.rs (Front, Keyed) and crates/base-db (leading_extensions)
what: The real front's key task has no way to get a stored file image: `Front::key` gets no store and `Keyed` returns keys, not image bytes, so a fresh process parses every file of every unit it keys (std's included) once. And the syntax extensions of a crate cannot be computed outside base-db (`leading_extensions` is pub(crate)), so the command images every file under `Extensions::NONE`, which keys a file that opts into a blaze extension wrong.
cost: not measured; the key floor (one hash and one lookup per unchanged file) is missed by a whole parse per file per process
cause: the seam was designed with a scripted front that had no files; the extension reader lives where only the database used it
whys: Front::key returns keys only; the host files images, the front cannot ask for them; base-db is the one reader of a crate's leading attributes
class: a seam between the driver and the front that carries keys but not the records a key is a lookup of
prevention: wanted: an image lookup on the Front seam (or the host handing gathered images in), and base-db's extension reader made public as one function both use
